headline: Panthers' Sandis Vilmanis exits game after hit by Capitals' Tom Wilson
take:
The scary part first: Sandis Vilmanis left Florida's game in Washington after a hit by Tom Wilson, who got a boarding major and a game misconduct, ESPN reports. There's no word yet on Vilmanis's condition, and we won't guess.

What the Panthers could lose is more than a depth forward's 12:32 a night. Vilmanis has seven points in 16 games, but the bigger number is what happens with him on the ice: 63% of the five-on-five expected goals, about 14 percentage points better than Florida does without him. He's the kind of player who makes a third line work. Wilson, meanwhile, has a long history with the league's Department of Player Safety, and we'd expect this hit to get a look. Washington won the game 4-3 without him, mostly at even strength.
